column3: Kuroneko Route · Fortuitous Witnessing
I didn't pay attention in class all the way up until when school ended.
It isn't bad to do something else once in a while after lessons or tests but...
Wearing my uniform and playing soccer, how did this happen?
...I don't feel like playing though. I'll just find some corner and idle away.
Hey Kousaka. Don't space out. The ball's coming!
Oh, Akagi. I'm deep in thought right now. So don't mind me.
Huh?
So just pretend like I'm not here and play your soccer, former soccer team member.
What are you saying? You better come around when we get the ball.
Yeah yeah, whatever you say, just go. Don't bother me.
Geez, I already made it clear, alright?
Well, that aside... how can I find a way to start a conversation with Kuroneko?
Hey, Kousaka! The ball is going in your direction!
Eh?
Guaaaaaaaaaaah!
Hey! Kousaka! Are you all right?
Owowowowowow...
After eating that right in the face, of course it hurts.
...Hey, aren't you being too coldhearted?
Who and where is that fellow who wasted my beautiful pass?
Besides it was your fault for spacing out. Normally you could have avoided that.
Guh...
Well, take a break for now.
Y-Yeah. Thanks...
Well, come back to the field if it doesn't hurt anymore.
Yeah.
Haha, this is nothing. It'll be healed in no time.
Tch, that bastard...
Wait... Huh? Over by the pool...
Are you for real......
God, if you exist, please accept my gratitude!
I knew you've been watching all this time, and now you decided to reward me!
Aahh. She hid herself...
Hey! The ball is coming at you again!
But it's too late! Your rare image has already been engraved into my retinas!
Guuuuaaaah～～!!
Not again... Owowoww.
Is this my punishment for seeing Kuroneko in her swimsuit...?
Hey, I'm really sorry. It wasn't on purpose this time.
You again～～!!
